messages:
Nina H: Quick sync 10AM PT webinar tomorrow. Two urgent items: RTMP fallback and replay segmentation for follow-ups.
Raj S: RTMP fallback? Are we streaming to LinkedIn as well?
Nina H: Yes. Primary is Zoom live. If Zoom stream drops, we need RTMP fallback to our backup CDN so viewers keep watching.
Elena V: Ops note: Zoom has RTMP configured but we need a monitoring webhook to switch traffic. ops-bot can monitor meeting health and flip to rtmp-backup if event.loss_rate > .05 for 15s.
ops-bot: Monitoring rule registered for meeting 2063001111. Fallback target: rtmp://cdn-backup.redwood.ai/events/inference-live-2063001111
Marco P: For replay segmentation: want three buckets -> replay_opt_in (full replay + transcript), highlights_only (short clips + 7-day public highlights), and no_followup (no emails). Need hidden form fields to map to HubSpot lists.
HubSpot-bot: Suggested mapping: replay_opt_in -> list: webinar-full, highlights_only -> list: webinar-highlights, no_followup -> list: webinar-no-touch.
Nina H: Reg page update: add radio choice with short copy explaining each option. Also add company size and use that to prioritize Sales routing.
Elena V: Zoom settings done: cloud_recording=true, rtmp_stream=true, auto_transcription=true, record_separate_audio_files=false, allow_cohost_start=true. Saved.
Raj S: Caption plan: immediate AWS Transcribe auto SRT on stop -> quick QA by ops -> Rev for final transcript only if demo quality is poor. Label versions: v0-auto, v1-ops-qa, v2-human.
Marco P: Post-event timelines: 0-6h push auto SRT + raw mp4 to /drive/Marketing/Events/Inference-Live/2063001111, 24h publish 3x social clips, 72h publish full replay to gated page for replay_opt_in.
Nina H: Also confirm GDPR wording for EU regs: replay delivery is a necessary service for the replay itself (consent implied), marketing emails still require explicit opt-in.
HubSpot-bot: Reminder: make marketing_opt_in a separate checkbox; map to webinar-marketing list only if checked.
Elena V: I'll add webhook to HubSpot that tags each lead with timezone and replay_choice. That will let SDRs filter APAC morning signups.
Raj S: One more: set Zoom to save chat transcript to cloud (we pull Q&A for highlight sizzle).
ops-bot: RTMP fallback tests scheduled at 08:00 PT tomorrow. Will post results in this thread.
Nina H: Perfect. Please mark done once RTMP pass and reg mapping confirmed. :white_check_mark:
